post.text:
Did you know?

Sometimes Minecraft will generate "arrow trees", which point to the Stronghold, which is a dungeon that you go to to reach the final boss of the game. https://t.co/QS2WeLLPz6

description.description: A top-down screenshot from the video game Minecraft, showing an acacia tree at the border of a savanna and desert biome. A thin red outline is drawn around the blocky canopy of the tree. The background features sand blocks and dead bushes.
